summary.text: Captain of the Halizones from far-off Alybe, where silver is born — whom Agamemnon thrust from his car and pierced through the breast when he turned first of all to flee on the day the gods roused the battle.

story.text: In the Catalogue, Odius and Epistrophus lead the Halizones from Alybe, far from the Paphlagonian coast where the Parthenius flows. When Ares and Athene set the Trojans and Danaans at one another in the aristeia of Book 5, each captain slew his man: first Agamemnon fixed his spear in great Odius' back between the shoulders as he fled, and drove it through his breast until he fell with a thud and his armour clanged.
